item.title: Burnham criticised for EV and North Sea drilling approach as wildfires heighten climate fears
item.summary: Reduction in EV sales targets could add millions of tonnes of CO2 to emissions as UK faces impact of global heating Andy Burnham has been criticised for moving to cut electric vehicle (EV) sales targets and accept North Sea drilling at a time of devastating wildfires caused by the climate emergency. The prime minister for the first time acknowledged on Friday that the climate crisis was behind hundreds of wildfires that have ripped across the parts of the UK. Continue reading...
